Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py

Finds groups of active records that are really the same family (same-sounding head
of household name and matching birth year, see registry/dedup.py). In each group it
keeps the record whose household ID passes the check digit, and marks every other
record in the group as 'merged' into the kept one. No record is deleted and no other
field of any record is changed.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id  # noqa: E402
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import load_households, save_households, set_status  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    by_id = {h.id: h for h in households}
    groups = find_duplicates(households)

    for ids in groups:
        valid = [i for i in ids if is_valid_household_id(i)]
        kept_id = valid[0] if valid else ids[0]   # groups are sorted by ID
        kept = by_id[kept_id]
        print(f"duplicate family: {', '.join(ids)}")
        print(f"  keeping {kept_id} ({kept.head.name}, {kept.region})")
        for other_id in ids:
            if other_id == kept_id:
                continue
            set_status(other_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
            other = by_id[other_id]
            other.status = "merged"
            other.merged_into = kept_id
            print(f"  marked {other_id} merged into {kept_id}")

    if groups:
        save_households(households)
    print(f"done: {len(groups)} duplicate group(s) merged")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""One-time script: merge duplicate household records in data/registry.json. MODIFIES DATA.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py

from registry.dedup import find_duplicates  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import load_households, save_households, set_status  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    by_id = {h.id: h for h in households}
    groups = find_duplicates(households)
    for ids in groups:
        valid = [i for i in ids if is_valid_household_id(i)]
        kept_id = valid[0] if valid else ids[0]
        kept = by_id[kept_id]
        print(f"merge group: {', '.join(ids)} -> keeping {kept_id} ({kept.head.name})")
        for other_id in ids:
            if other_id == kept_id:
                continue
            other = by_id[other_id]
            set_status(other_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
            other.status = "merged"
            other.merged_into = kept_id
            print(f"  marked {other_id} merged into {kept_id}")
